mathematical_premises: For each iid coordinate pair, the unnormalised ambiguity factor F(d,u)=int f(x)f(x-d) exp(iu(2x-d)) dx satisfies intint |F|^2 = pi (int f^2)^2 <= pi.
The independent-copy identity is Q(X)-Q(X')=(X-X')^T A (X+X') plus affine difference; dependence inside each sum/difference pair is retained inside F.
Cauchy-Schwarz is applied once in the full physical difference variables before any reciprocal coefficient is paid.
The square-peel receiver converts a translation-uniform half-Riesz bound on the residual into an L-infinity density bound uniformly in the random square center.

new_results.symmetric_3d_BL_obstruction: For every symmetric 3x3 A, BL((d_i,(Ad)_i); p_i=1/2)=infinity. After shearing off the diagonal, kernel generators k1=(0,-b,a), k2=(c,0,-a), k3=(-c,b,0) sum to zero and their span violates the BL dimension condition.
new_results.bipartite_Moyal_CS: For k+k independent physical coordinates and R=X^T C X+2X^T B Y+Y^T D Y+affine with arbitrary symmetric C,D and invertible kxk B, |phi_R(t)|^2 <= pi^k |det B|^-1 |t|^-k.
new_results.critical_k2_half_Riesz: For k=2, sup_s E|R-s|^-1/2 <= 4sqrt(2)|det B|^-1/4; a disjoint physical square d[Z+h]^2 gives ||p_Q||inf <= 4sqrt(2)|d|^-1/2|det B|^-1/4. Continuity not claimed for this square-peel branch.
new_results.k_ge_3_density: For k>=3, phi_R is L1 and ||p_R||inf <= [k/(k-2)]|det B|^-1/k, with continuous C0 density.

partner_result_applied.actual_inequality: For A_m=[1] direct_sum J_m/m direct_sum (-J_m/m), m even, peel d=1 and split both rank-one banks evenly. The cross packet has Z2=1/16, hence ||p||inf <= 8sqrt(2)e^(1/4)=14.52708926969255 uniformly in m.

unresolved_implication: From s3(A)>=1 alone, obtain a product-preserving universal-scale route to an invertible square crossing, a physical square plus aggregate Z2, or an existing diagonal/pivot/grouped-hub/ridge/three-volume exit. A bare symmetric three-coordinate phase-space BL block is impossible by the new obstruction.
next_step: Study rank-deficient rectangular physical crossings using partial Moyal integration and exterior-volume aggregation, aiming to interpolate the exact square-invertible Cauchy-Schwarz theorem with the partner Z2 theorem without selecting one bad minor.
